The [[Fastbreeder|hex droids]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sebaddon]] were controlled by a '''coordinating intelligence complex''' on Sebaddon. During [[Independent Operation Sebaddon]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] led an assault on the facility in order to destroy the hexes.
